# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia | 0406 295 160 | ns.anoop@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Senior Quality Engineer and QA Lead with over 19 years of experience delivering end-to-end quality strategies across native mobile applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise payment systems. Proven track record of designing robust mobile test automation frameworks using Espresso, XCUITest, and Playwright, while seamlessly integrating automated quality gates into Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. Google Cloud Generative AI certified specialist skilled in applying modern AI coding tools like GitHub Copilot to optimize test coverage, lead defect triage, and drive cross-functional release assurance within Agile environments.

* **Mobile Quality Engineering:** Native iOS Testing (XCUITest), Native Android Testing (Espresso, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), Risk-Based Testing, Production Verification Testing, Regression Testing
* **Test Automation & API Testing:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Robolectric, API Gateway Automation, End-to-End Test Suite Architecture
* **CI/CD & DevOps Engineering:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), Slack API Integration, GitHub
* **AI & Engineering Tooling:** Custom GitHub Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Automated PR Review Workflows, AI-Driven Unit Testing
* **QA Leadership & Process:** QA Team Lead, Defect Triage & Severity Prioritization, Cross-Functional Release Management, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership, Data Integrity Validation, Agile/Scrum
* **Domain Expertise:** Card Payment Processing & Schemes, Android Payment Terminal Architecture, Digital Wallets, ISO/APACS Standards, Mobile Ticketing Applications
* **Languages & Frameworks:** Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, React
* **Test Management & Observability:** JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM, Dynatrace
